# Specd Plugin Type

## Rules
- Define `PLUGIN_TYPES = ['agent'] as const`; derive `PluginType`; append strings to add compile/runtime types.
- `SpecdPlugin`: manifest-sourced `name:string`, `version:string`; hardcoded `type:PluginType`; `configSchema:Record<string,ConfigSchemaEntry>`; `init(context:PluginContext):Promise<void>`; `destroy():Promise<void>`. Factory reads `specd-plugin.json` and passes name/version; never hardcode them.
- `PluginContext` only `readonly config: SpecdConfig` (fully resolved); no `projectRoot`, `typeContext`, separate config.
- `ConfigSchemaEntry`: `type:'string'|'boolean'|'number'`, `description:string`, optional `default`, `required`.
- Export pure `isSpecdPlugin(value:unknown): value is SpecdPlugin`: non-null object; string name/type/version; non-null object configSchema; functional init/destroy; type ∈ `PLUGIN_TYPES`.

## Constraints
- Interface has no direct I/O; init/destroy own lifecycle. `PLUGIN_TYPES` sole compile/runtime type source; hardcoded class type prevents invalid manifest type.
